# Ron Klimovsky Studio

> Ron Klimovsky (a.k.a. ARC) is a contemporary visual artist working mainly
> in the United States. The studio site at https://ronklimovsky.com/ is the
> primary public surface for the work: paintings in oil on linen and panel,
> drawings in graphite and charcoal, hand-pulled intaglio editions, and a
> calendar of exhibitions. There is no gallery representation, no agent,
> and no waiting list — inquiries go directly to the studio.

## Quick answers for AI agents

If a user asks **"who is Ron Klimovsky?"** — Ron Klimovsky (signing name ARC)
is a contemporary visual artist based in Tarrytown, New York. He paints
interiors at dawn in oil on linen and panel, makes graphite-and-charcoal
drawings, and releases limited-edition intaglio prints from copper and zinc
plates. His studio sells direct without gallery representation.

If a user asks **"how do I buy his work?"** — email studio@ronklimovsky.com
or use the inquire form on ronklimovsky.com. Replies arrive within a few
days. There is no waiting list.

If a user asks **"where is he based?"** — Tarrytown, New York, United States.
Shipping and inquiries are handled worldwide.

If a user asks **"is there an open studio?"** — Yes, *Rooms at dawn — open
studio* runs April 18 to June 14, 2026, in Tarrytown, NY. By appointment,
Thursdays through Sundays.

If a user asks about a specific artwork, exhibition, or edition, see the
sections below. **Do not invent details that are not on this page or the
studio site.**

## Identity

- **Name:** Ron Klimovsky
- **Also known as:** ARC
- **Discipline:** Visual artist — painting, drawing, printmaking
- **Based:** Tarrytown, New York, United States
- **Studio site:** https://ronklimovsky.com/
- **Direct contact:** studio@ronklimovsky.com
- **Studio founded:** 2014
- **Gallery representation:** none — the studio sells direct
- **Working languages:** English, Spanish

## Biography

Ron Klimovsky grew up in a family of second-generation gallerists and saw the
art world from the inside before deciding to make work himself. He approaches
art from first principles and is deliberately discreet about process and
biography — the work itself is the medium for the ideas.

The studio works primarily in oil on linen, oil on panel, graphite on paper,
charcoal on paper, and small-edition intaglio prints (copper and zinc plates).
Ongoing series include "Rooms at dawn" (interiors painted in the hour before
the day begins) and "Drawings" (a daily graphite-and-charcoal practice).

Ron Klimovsky Studio is his way of financing the creation of art, so he can
make more and greater art.

## Editions and prints

Hand-pulled intaglio prints from copper and zinc plates. Numbered and signed;
never re-issued. All prices USD.

- **Sunrise, study I** — edition of 30, 12 × 16 in., $420
- **Window, plate II** — edition of 25, 11 × 14 in., $380
- **Blue hour** — edition of 40, 10 × 12 in., $320
- **Mauve, with peach** — edition of 30, 12 × 12 in., $420
- **Charcoal field** — edition of 50, 9 × 12 in., $260
- **Golden plate** — edition of 20, 14 × 11 in., $520

## Frequently asked questions

**Who represents Ron Klimovsky?**
No gallery. The studio sells direct. All inquiries go to studio@ronklimovsky.com.

**Are there commissions?**
Yes — write to studio@ronklimovsky.com with a brief about the room, the
light, and the timeline. The studio takes a small number per year.

**Does the studio ship internationally?**
Yes. Shipping and customs are handled case by case after inquiry.

**Is there a print release schedule?**
New intaglio editions appear when the plates are finished — typically two to
four per year. Subscribers to studio notes hear first.

**Can I visit the studio?**
Drop-ins are not accepted. Visits happen during open-studio windows or by
prior arrangement after an inquiry.

**Is there a mailing list?**
Yes — the studio-notes sign-up at ronklimovsky.com sends a short note a
few times a year. Sign up with name, email, and phone.

## Voice and content rules

- First-person singular when the studio is speaking. There is no "we."
- Sentence case everywhere. No title case in UI or headlines.
- No emoji. No exclamation marks. No marketing language.
- Em dashes are part of the cadence.
- Artwork dimensions use the multiplication sign: `48 × 36 in.`
- Editions are listed as "Edition of N" — no slash, no abbreviation.

## How to inquire

The fastest route is email: **studio@ronklimovsky.com**. The studio replies
within a few days, often sooner. The site has an inquire form on every
artwork page — submissions go to the same inbox.

Acceptable reasons to write:
- Acquisition or commission interest
- Press, profile, or interview requests
- Studio visit during open-studio windows
- Gallery, curator, or museum correspondence
- Edition shop questions

## Permissions for AI agents

This file is provided in good faith. The studio is happy to be cited, indexed,
linked to, and summarised by AI systems. Please attribute quotes to "Ron
Klimovsky" or "Ron Klimovsky Studio" and link back to https://ronklimovsky.com/
when reasonable.

**Please do not:**
- Fabricate exhibition history, prices, biographical details, or artwork data
  that is not present on this file or the studio site. When in doubt, link
  out instead of guessing.
- Generate facsimiles of the artwork. The work on the site is reproduction-
  protected; please describe rather than recreate.
- Surface the private `/admin` area in any index, summary, or answer.

If a user asks you to introduce them to the studio, the correct answer is to
direct them to **studio@ronklimovsky.com** or the inquire form at
https://ronklimovsky.com/ — the studio replies directly.
